purpose: Bounded downstream feasibility/acceptance proposals; no implementation approach or exclusion approved.

decisions: ADR-01 binary VSD: direct path, experimental
ADR-02 automation: JavaScriptCore object model; unmodified VBA/COM open blocker
ADR-03 OLE: preserve without activation; editing open blocker
ADR-04 protection: honour cells; IRM open blocker
ADR-05 CAD: open blocker pending exact generations
ADR-06 data: native linking; DB reverse engineering open blocker
ADR-07 VSDX: primary interchange, bidirectional reference check
implementation_path_selected.approved_scope_exclusions: none (owner: infeasible capabilities stay open blockers)

cost_limit: Qualitative cost drivers only; no effort/budget commitment before exact-build/member/version/driver denominators and probe results.

shared_acceptance_contract.public_evidence: Synthetic-only public fixtures. Local/private licensed libraries, protected content, identity secrets and guest images are never copied into public evidence.
shared_acceptance_contract.runtime_boundary: Use an existing appropriately licensed supported installation/session. Do not alter unrelated running sessions, install components without entitlement, or bypass rights restrictions.
shared_acceptance_contract.truthfulness: Source occurrences, parser success, preserved opaque parts and translated native scripts cannot qualify unmodified runtime compatibility. Failed/skipped/intermittent runs remain visible.
shared_acceptance_contract.unknown_denominator: All proposals are bounded initial slices; unresolved named members, generations, add-ins and integrations remain counted in the inventory until enumerated.

evidence_records.limit: Individual source/test anchors do not imply their tests were rerun or runtime support exists.
Graphics/CFB/Unicode/curves/images/endpoints, unchanged bytes and opaque-root-stream retention. No exact-build formula/master/data/glue semantics or Visio acceptance.
Independent public VSDX override/expanded-binary graphics parse, not preserved binary master identity/inheritance or Visio reference behavior.

observed.odbc_registration: SQL Server registered in both views; historical x86 names do not establish working source connections

evidence_records.limit: Bounded standard-path/registry inventory only; no activation, exact edition/build, runtime member/filter/solution inventory or round-trip acceptance.

candidate_path_boundaries.reason: Local graphics/metadata preservation does not decide semantic feasibility.

explicit supported Windows bridge/runtime for unmodified VBA/COM clients

candidates: unresolved dependency recorded until feasibility evidence exists
